revisionDesc.change: General - Take care that one correction by Weisser-Gericke does not overwrite or be overwritten by Strauss Korr Tyche correction

Submit - In fr. 1 l. 2-3, I corrected ἀναγρ[αφόμεν]ος ἐν κώμῃ Φαι[νίππ]ου into καταγεν[όμε]νος ἐν κώμῃ Φαι[νίππ]ου. Braunert, Binnenwanderung p. 191 n. 327 already stated that [ἀφʼ Ἡρ]ακλέους πόλεως ἀναγρ[αφόμεν]ος ἐν κώμῃ Φαι[νίππ]ου would be "singulär" and speculated that [ἀφʼ Ἡρ]ακλέους πόλεως was a mistake for [ἀφ' Ἡρ]ακλεοπολίτου. The problem that someone was registered (anagraphomenos) in a different place than the one he was "from" is solved by this new reading: This person was domiciled (katagenomenos) in a different place than his ἰδία, not registered. Cf. as a parallel, e.g., BGU II 651.2-3: ἀπὸ τῆς μητ(ροπόλεως) καταγενομένου ἐν κώμῃ Καρανίδι. For the shape of κατα in καταγεν[όμε]νος cf. the κατα of καταπαντήσασά in CPR I 238 fr. 1 l. 6. The nu of καταγεν[όμε]νος at the end of fr. 1 l. 2 is “stair-step” shaped, with the stroke connecting the two outer vertical lines being horizontal rather than diagonal; this is found in some other nus in the text, too, though not quite as pronounced (cf., e.g., the final nu of ἐν]δημῶν in fr. 3 l. 3).
